rules.accepted_credit_types: CE addressing the CRNP's specialty from providers listed in 49 Pa. Code §21.334(a) (CRNP programs, national nursing/medical/osteopathic/pharmaceutical organizations, nursing specialty organizations, other boards' APRN-approved programs) or Board-approved courses; 1 hour = 50 minutes; up to 4 hours for teaching, precepting or publications

topics.who: All CRNPs; approved training in recognizing and reporting child abuse (3 hours for initial certification)
CRNPs with prescriptive authority approval; part of the 30 hours
CRNPs with prescriptive authority (ABC-MAP/Act 124): pain management, identification of addiction or opioid prescribing/dispensing; part of the total; once per renewal period
All RNs from May 1, 2026: organ donation and tissue recovery, once within 5 years

rules.notes: Certification renews every 2 years ($81; prescriptive authority renewal $41). Prescribers also need a one-time 4 hours of opioid education (2 h pain management/addiction + 2 h prescribing) when first applying for prescriptive authority. Waivers possible for illness or hardship.
